mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_credential (id, account_id, credential_type, status) VALUES (#{credential.id}, #{credential.accountId}, #{credential.credentialType}, #{credential.status})
mapper.select: SELECT credential.id AS credential_id, credential.account_id, account.subject_id, account.scope_type, account.scope_id, subject.display_name, password.password_hash, credential.status AS credential_status, account.status AS account_status, account.second_factor_required, subject.status AS subject_status, credential.version AS credential_version FROM iam_credential credential JOIN iam_password password ON password.credential_id = credential.id JOIN iam_account account ON account.id = credential.account_id AND account.deleted = 0 JOIN iam_subject subject ON subject.id = account.subject_id AND subject.deleted = 0 WHERE credential.account_id = #{accountId} AND credential.credential_type = 'PASSWORD' AND credential.deleted = 0
mapper.update: WITH target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT credential.id FROM iam_credential credential JOIN iam_password password ON password.credential_id = credential.id WHERE credential.id = #{credentialId} AND credential.account_id = #{accountId} AND credential.credential_type = 'PASSWORD' AND credential.version = #{version} AND credential.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE ), updated_password AS ( UPDATE iam_password SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE credential_id IN (SELECT id FROM target) RETURNING credential_id ) UPDATE iam_credential SET status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT credential_id FROM updated_password)
